title: epochal-nvtx-sampler-and-staggered-prefetch-microbench
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: We need a low-overhead, phase-aware sampler and a microbenchmark harness that exercises staggered prefetch and prefix reuse patterns to validate scheduler + KV cache changes. This PR introduces an epochal NVTX-like sampler that emits coarse phase markers with adaptive sample rates to keep tracing overhead sub-1% at production QPS and a small C++/Python microbench driver to sweep inter-arrival jitter and prefix-reuse ratios. The sampler purpose-built for our runtime groups short-lived requests into epoch ranges so tracing and counter collection can be correlated to scheduling decisions without flooding the trace stream. The microbench generates realistic request shapes (varying seq-lengths, prefix hits/misses, small bursts) and records a compact perf summary exported to our perf dashboard. Changes are split into three parts: 1) runtime tracing: epochal_sampler (C++) with adaptive backoff, lightweight per-thread counters, and a user-visible API for marking candidate epochs; 2) microbench: staggered_prefetch_driver (C++ core + Python harness) that can replay request arrival patterns and validate KV cache steady-state behavior; 3) observability: a small exporter that converts epochal samples into sequence-length heatmaps and a new dashboard panel showing epoch churn vs. token throughput. This PR includes benchmark results (attached), a short doc with recommended sampling knobs, and tests that assert sampling overheads and microbench deterministic modes. Risk: sampler changes touch hotpath tracing and counter increment points; added careful lock-free counters and a configurable opt-out for customers. Rollout plan: feature gated behind "epochal-sampler" flag; staged rollout to canaries for 48h with perf thresholds. Related: closes ENG-1973, references SUP-4421.
commits_summary: c1: add epochal_sampler implementation and unit tests; c2: add staggered_prefetch microbench core and harness; c3: perf exporter and dashboard panels; c4: docs and runbook; c5: fix flake in sampler race-case and add CI perf baseline
ci_checks: perf-regression: passed (no regression against main for 95p latency)
review_thread: Marcus Liu: Can we get an explicit microbenchmark that measures sampling overhead at 10k qps? Priya: Added a deterministic mode in the harness and new CI perf job measuring overhead at 10k and 40k qps; results attached in PR. Aisha Kapoor: Please ensure counters are lock-free on contention paths. Priya: switched counters to atomic fetch_add and added a contention test. Ben Thompson: Dashboard panel looks good but can you bucket epoch durations into logarithmic ranges? Priya: changed exporter to use log buckets and added example queries. Marcus Liu: Verified numbers in canaries; approving. Aisha Kapoor: LGTM after small nits. Merge approved by release lead.
release_notes: Added epochal sampling for low-overhead phase markers and a staggered-prefetch microbenchmark harness that helps validate KV cache and scheduler improvements. Includes observability exporter and dashboard panel for epoch churn vs throughput.
